lines.text: Everyone must submit to the governing authorities, because there is no authority except what is from God.
Whoever resists authority brings judgment on himself, but those who do what is right will have the ruler's approval.
The one in authority is God's servant for your good, and he does not carry the spear in vain.
Paul says to submit as a matter of conscience, and this is also why you pay tithes.
Pay everyone what you owe: taxes, revenue, respect, and honor to whom each is due.
